description: This file defines the CacheConfig interface and its associated enum CacheConfigValue, providing configuration settings for caches used in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes method signatures for retrieving cache properties like maximum size and expiration durations, as well as a method to render the configuration into a Config object.

classes.name: CacheConfig
classes.description: An interface specifying configuration properties for a cache, such as maximum size and expiration durations, along with a method to render the config into a Config object.

methods.name: getMaximumSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum size of a cache.

methods.name: getExpireAfterWrite
methods.description: Returns the duration after which a written cache entry expires.

methods.name: getExpireAfterAccess
methods.description: Returns the duration after which an accessed cache entry expires.

methods.name: getExpireAfterCreate
methods.description: Returns the duration after which a created cache entry expires.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders this config into a Config object for reconstruction purposes.
